data.description: The Wall Rock Climber is a green freestanding climbing wall dotted with multi-colour holds. At 8 ft tall and 12 ft long, it gives several children room to climb side by side, each picking a route across the coloured holds. Rock climbing asks children to plan the next move, test their footing and use their legs as much as their arms. Schools often use a wall like this for structured play during games periods, while societies place it as a standalone challenge for older children. Because it is freestanding, it can go near a boundary or in the middle of a lawn. Our 3-year warranty covers galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts and composite laminates against manufacturing defects. Ask us for a layout drawing with the wall marked on your site.

items.pText: The Wall Rock Climber is a green freestanding climbing wall dotted with multi-colour holds. At 8 ft tall and 12 ft long, it gives several children room to climb side by side, each picking a route across the coloured holds. Rock climbing asks children to plan the next move, test their footing and use their legs as much as their arms. Schools often use a wall like this for structured play during games periods, while societies place it as a standalone challenge for older children. Because it is freestanding, it can go near a boundary or in the middle of a lawn. Our 3-year warranty covers galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts and composite laminates against manufacturing defects. Ask us for a layout drawing with the wall marked on your site.

props.pText: The wall stands on its own frame and is made from weather-proof, corrosion-resistant materials. We install it self-standing or grouted. Lay an impact-absorbing surface along the full climbing face, check every hold for tightness during maintenance, and replace any hold that turns or cracks before children use the wall again.
